simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֹצֶם (H6108) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עֹצֶם (ʻôtsem) means power ; hence, body First listed occurrence: Deut 8 17.

definitions.full: H6108. otsem עֹ֫צֶם noun [masculine] might, bones ; — 1 might , construct ׳י יָדִי Deut 8:17 , ׳י יָָֽדְךָ Job 30:21 ; suffix עָצְמָהֿ Nahum 3:9 (Ges § 93e ); + ׳בְּי רוּחז Isa 11:15 (Thes and others; for ר ׳בַּעְיָם ᵑ0 ). 2 bones (collective): suffix עָצְמִי Psa 139:15 = my frame .
